items.ref: Mo go ene, e ne e le ka ga boitshupo jwa go nna Moaforika.

items.hyp: Tonakgolo ya Bosetšhaba ya dipusosele Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma o ne a boleletse bašwa kwa Kapa Bophirima go emelela Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ka ntlha ya go tshwanela bašwa ba ba itsege ba ba tshwanetsego mo mafelong a a fetileng.
items.ref: Tona ya Taolo ya tsa Kgwebo Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma o kopile borradipolotiki ba kwa Kapa Botlhaba go latela Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ka go baya pele bontsi jwa batho ba ba sotlegang ba ba kwa mafelong a magaeng.

items.hyp: O ne a bua kwa kokolegong ya go tlhola mo moletlong wa Mbizana wa kwa Mafelong a a ne a leela mo go tlhola moletlo wa African National Congress (ANC) wa maloba, Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
items.ref: O ne a bua kwa moletlong wa phetolo ya leina la Mmasepala wa Mbizana le le neng le bidiwa go kaya tlotlo go moikanyi wa African National Congress (ANC), Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Re tshwanetse go tlhoka go nna le tlhokego ya go tshwanetse go tshwanela molao le naga ya rona jaaka re ne re tlhokafetse mo mofong wa gagwe wa molao.
items.ref: Re tshwanetse go aga setshwantsho sa bokamoso se se ntšha go lefelo le le  mo nageng ya rona jaaka re bitsa  mmasepala ono ka ena.

items.hyp: Metshameko, matshelo, ditlhopho, le matshelo a a tshwanang le go tlhoka ka nako e e tshwanang le fa re tshwanetse go tlhokafala gore re tlaa tshwanetse go tlaa tshwanela le lelapa la batho ba ba tshwanetseng, go tlaa go tla nna.
items.ref: Tlala, lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano ke dingwe tse re tshwanetseng go lwana le tsona ka dikakanyo tsotlhe tsa rona mme jaaka re tlogela leina la Mmasepala wa selegae la Mbizana, re tshwanetse gape go netefatsa gore re dira ka natla go tlogela dilo tsotlhe tse di neng di le morwalo mo go bathong ba rona.

items.hyp: Mminokutlhe wa ga Khomišene ya Ditirelo tsa Bosetšhaba le Ditirelo tsa Bokgoni (COGTA), Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o tlhagelela go tlhagelela kwa go tlhagelekeng ga gagwe kwa ntle ga gagwe kwa Mmasepala wa Mbizana.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmusepe wa mofitlhe wa kwa mafelong a a fetileng a a neng a tlhagelela, Daniswa Mafumbatha, a re ga go na le ditirelo tse di tshwanang le go netefatsa batho ba a neng a tshwanetse go tswa mo molao wa bona wa kgaratlho.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha o buile gore go tlhola moletlo wa masepala go tlhagelela ditlamorago tse dingwe.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a le moikano wa ntlha mme go neelana ka gore mofuta wa gagwe o tlaa tshwanetse go tshwanela ka bontsi le gape re ka re tlhagisa gore o ne o tlaa tshwanetse go tlaa nna le molao wa mama Winnie.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Batho ba tlaa tshwanetse go bona le mofuta mme ka ntlha ya gore, go na le tlhakatlhakano e e tshwanang le tlhakatlhakano.
items.ref: Batho ba tla goroga go bona sefikantswe,  e bile go na le mananeo a a ka rulagantsweng teng.

items.hyp: Mmueledi wa Ditlhopho wa Batsamaisi kwa Frere Hospital kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead, o ne a boleletse gore go tlhagelela go tlhagelela moletlo wa matsholo mo go tshwara ka nako ya kgwedi ya Botlhaba e e fetileng go lebelela go tswa moletlo wa coronavirus go tswa mo ngwageng e e fetileng.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.
